response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL)) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind, p.cnt AS trader_count, CAST(p.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_average FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > s.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Traders with a NULL tradekind form one group, shown with a NULL trader type.
The average is the plain mean of per-type counts, with the NULL-type group included. Division is done in floating point with no rounding.
